classes/bayushi-deceiver-627.name: Sneak Attack
classes/bayushi-deceiver-627.description: Sneak attack improves by +1d6 at 1st level and again at 3rd, 5th, 7th, and 9th level, reaching +5d6 at 9th level.

classes/bayushi-deceiver-627.name: Poison Use
classes/bayushi-deceiver-627.description: At 1st level you are trained in poison use and do not risk accidentally poisoning yourself when applying poison to a blade.

classes/bayushi-deceiver-627.name: Strike First, Strike Last
classes/bayushi-deceiver-627.description: At 2nd level add your Intelligence modifier to initiative checks in addition to your Dexterity modifier.

classes/bayushi-deceiver-627.name: Scorpion Feint
classes/bayushi-deceiver-627.description: At 4th level gain a +2 competence bonus on Bluff checks made to feint a humanoid in combat. After a successful feint, gain a +2 circumstance bonus on the next attack roll against that opponent.

classes/bayushi-deceiver-627.name: Improved Disarm
classes/bayushi-deceiver-627.description: At 6th level gain Improved Disarm as a bonus feat even without the normal Expertise prerequisite.

classes/bayushi-deceiver-627.name: Opportunist
classes/bayushi-deceiver-627.description: At 8th level gain the opportunist ability, allowing an attack of opportunity against an opponent just struck for damage in melee by another character, subject to the source timing limits.

classes/bayushi-deceiver-627.name: Improved Critical
classes/bayushi-deceiver-627.description: At 10th level gain Improved Critical as a bonus feat for one chosen weapon type for which the source feat is legal.

classes/guild-thief-514.name: Sneak Attack
classes/guild-thief-514.description: Sneak attack is +1d6 at 1st level, +2d6 at 3rd level, and +3d6 at 5th level.

classes/guild-thief-514.name: Doublespeak
classes/guild-thief-514.description: At 1st level gain a +2 competence bonus on Bluff, Diplomacy, and Innuendo checks.

classes/guild-thief-514.name: Bonus Feat
classes/guild-thief-514.description: At 2nd level and again at 4th level choose one source-listed guild thief bonus feat, meeting its prerequisites unless the selected source feat says otherwise.

classes/guild-thief-514.name: Uncanny Dodge
classes/guild-thief-514.description: At 2nd level retain your Dexterity bonus to AC when caught flat-footed or struck by an invisible attacker. At 5th level you can no longer be flanked except as allowed by the source's higher-level rogue exception.

classes/guild-thief-514.name: Reputation
classes/guild-thief-514.description: Your guild reputation bonus is +1 at 3rd level, +2 at 4th level, and +3 at 5th level, applied in the source-defined social situations.

classes/enlightened-spirit-267.name: Aura of Courage
classes/enlightened-spirit-267.description: At 1st level become immune to fear and grant nearby allies the source-defined morale bonus on saves against fear while you are conscious.

classes/enlightened-spirit-267.name: Aura of Menace
classes/enlightened-spirit-267.description: At 1st level project an aura of menace that can impose the source-defined penalties on hostile creatures that fail their saving throw.

classes/enlightened-spirit-267.name: Spirit Blast
classes/enlightened-spirit-267.description: At 1st level gain spirit blast, an eldritch essence that changes your eldritch blast to deal the source-defined sacred damage against qualifying evil outsiders and undead.

classes/enlightened-spirit-267.name: Eldritch Blast
classes/enlightened-spirit-267.description: Your eldritch blast damage increases by +1d6 at 2nd level and by another +1d6 at 4th, 6th, 8th, and 10th level, for +5d6 total from this class.

classes/enlightened-spirit-267.name: Spirit Armor
classes/enlightened-spirit-267.description: Gain the source-defined sacred armor bonus of +1 at 2nd level, +2 at 6th level, and +3 at 10th level.

classes/enlightened-spirit-267.name: Celestial Flight
classes/enlightened-spirit-267.description: At 3rd level gain the source-defined celestial flight invocation and its flight capability.

classes/enlightened-spirit-267.name: Tongues
classes/enlightened-spirit-267.description: At 4th level gain the source-defined tongues ability, allowing communication as described by the class feature.

classes/enlightened-spirit-267.name: Shape Invocation
classes/enlightened-spirit-267.description: At 5th level learn one blast shape invocation of the source-allowed grade. The exact invocation selection remains tied to the reviewed invocation catalog rather than being replaced by a free-text choice.

classes/enlightened-spirit-267.name: Energy Resistance 5
classes/enlightened-spirit-267.description: At 5th level choose two different energy types from acid, cold, electricity, and fire; gain resistance 5 to each chosen type.

classes/enlightened-spirit-267.name: Holy Blast
classes/enlightened-spirit-267.description: At 7th level gain holy blast, an eldritch essence with the source-defined extra effect against qualifying evil creatures.

classes/enlightened-spirit-267.name: Transform Magic
classes/enlightened-spirit-267.description: At 9th level gain transform magic, the source-defined supernatural ability for countering or dispelling magic and receiving its associated benefit.

classes/enlightened-spirit-267.name: Death Ward
classes/enlightened-spirit-267.description: At 10th level gain the source-defined continuous death ward protection while the class feature remains available.

classes/hellfire-warlock-463.name: Hellfire Blast
classes/hellfire-warlock-463.description: Hellfire blast adds +2d6 damage per Hellfire Warlock class level to an eldritch blast, reaching +6d6 at 3rd level. Each use deals 1 point of Constitution damage to you; a creature without a Constitution score or immune to ability damage cannot use it.

classes/hellfire-warlock-463.name: Hellfire Infusion
classes/hellfire-warlock-463.description: At 2nd level, as a swift action, infuse the next charged magic item you activate with one source-listed modification. Uses per day equal your Charisma modifier, minimum one; the dynamic maximum remains source state rather than a fabricated fixed counter.

classes/hellfire-warlock-463.name: Hellfire Shield
classes/hellfire-warlock-463.description: At 3rd level gain hellfire shield. Activating it is an immediate action and deals 1 point of Constitution damage to you; its retaliatory damage and saving throw follow the source feature.

classes/fist-of-dal-quor-814.name: Stunning Strike
classes/fist-of-dal-quor-814.description: At 1st level gain Stunning Strike a number of times per day equal to your Fist of Dal Quor class level. It follows the source's weapon-based stunning rules; power points can increase the save DC, and characters with Stunning Fist use the source's shared-use interaction.

classes/fist-of-dal-quor-814.name: Sudden Strike
classes/fist-of-dal-quor-814.description: Sudden strike is +1d6 at 1st level, +2d6 at 3rd level, and +3d6 at 5th level.

classes/fist-of-dal-quor-814.name: Resilient Mind
classes/fist-of-dal-quor-814.description: At 2nd level gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting spells and abilities as defined by the source.

classes/fist-of-dal-quor-814.name: Resilient Soul
classes/fist-of-dal-quor-814.description: At 4th level gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against psionic powers and psi-like abilities.

classes/inquisitor-of-the-drowning-godde.name: Fear Aura
classes/inquisitor-of-the-drowning-godde.description: Once per day, as a standard action, project a 20-foot fear aura for 1 round per Inquisitor of the Drowning Goddess class level. Affected creatures make the source-defined Will save against DC 10 + class level + Charisma modifier.

classes/inquisitor-of-the-drowning-godde.name: Mien of Justice
classes/inquisitor-of-the-drowning-godde.description: Gain a +4 source-defined bonus on Intimidate and Sense Motive checks at 1st level; the bonus increases to +8 at 5th level.

classes/inquisitor-of-the-drowning-godde.name: Grappling Adhesive
classes/inquisitor-of-the-drowning-godde.description: At 2nd level the source adhesive preparation grants a +2 bonus on grapple checks; at 4th level that bonus improves to +4. Preparation and application remain explicit source state.

classes/inquisitor-of-the-drowning-godde.name: Devoted Mind
classes/inquisitor-of-the-drowning-godde.description: At 3rd level gain a +4 bonus on saving throws against charm, compulsion, and glamer effects.

classes/inquisitor-of-the-drowning-godde.name: Mark of the Outcast
classes/inquisitor-of-the-drowning-godde.description: At 4th level gain Mark of the Outcast. Its target selection, application, and downstream consequences remain source-adjudicated until the persistent mark-state subsystem is modeled.

classes/inquisitor-of-the-drowning-godde.name: Body-Coating Adhesive
classes/inquisitor-of-the-drowning-godde.description: At 5th level gain the source-defined body-coating adhesive option. Preparing and applying the coating remain explicit persistent state rather than an automatic combat modifier.
